te: The new St. Peter's Basilica in Rome is consecrated.
dz: 罗马新建的圣彼得会圣殿被尊崇.
de: The new St. Peter's Basilica in Rome is consecrated.

t: 蒂里亚克·哈桑·帕夏(德语:Tiryaki Hasan Pasha)是一名奥斯曼省省长,他击溃…
te: Tiryaki Hasan Pasha, an Ottoman provincial governor, routs the Habsburg forces commanded by Archduke Ferdinand II of Au…
dz: 蒂里亚克·哈桑·帕夏(德语:Tiryaki Hasan Pasha)是一名奥斯曼省省长,他击溃了由奥地利大公斐迪南二世所指挥的哈布斯堡部队,当时他们正在围攻纳吉克尼扎.
de: Tiryaki Hasan Pasha, an Ottoman provincial governor, routs the Habsburg forces commanded by Archduke Ferdinand II of Austria who were besieging Nagykanizsa.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布首先看到了现在称为波多黎各的岛屿。
te: Christopher Columbus first sights the island now known as Puerto Rico.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布首先看到了现在称为波多黎各的岛屿。
de: Christopher Columbus first sights the island now known as Puerto Rico.

t: 荷兰 Grote Hollandse Waard 的一座堤坝决口，造成约 10,000 人死亡。
te: A dike in the Grote Hollandse Waard in the Netherlands breaks, killing about 10,000 people.
dz: 圣伊丽莎白洪水：荷兰 Grote Hollandse Waard 的一座堤坝决口，造成约 10,000 人死亡。
de: St Elizabeth's flood: A dike in the Grote Hollandse Waard in the Netherlands breaks, killing about 10,000 people.

t: 教宗博尼法斯八世发行了教宗公牛乌纳姆圣克塔姆,宣称教宗的精神至上.
te: Pope Boniface VIII issues the Papal bull Unam sanctam, claiming spiritual supremacy for the papacy.
dz: 教宗博尼法斯八世发行了教宗公牛乌纳姆圣克塔姆,宣称教宗的精神至上.
de: Pope Boniface VIII issues the Papal bull Unam sanctam, claiming spiritual supremacy for the papacy.

t: 教宗英诺森特三世在答应承认教宗对西西里王国的控制后,将神圣罗马皇帝奥托四世驱逐出入侵西西里王国.
te: Pope Innocent III excommunicates Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV for invading the Kingdom of Sicily after promising to recog…
dz: 教宗英诺森特三世在答应承认教宗对西西里王国的控制后,将神圣罗马皇帝奥托四世驱逐出入侵西西里王国.
de: Pope Innocent III excommunicates Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV for invading the Kingdom of Sicily after promising to recognize papal control over it.

t: 马吉努尔福被选为安提波佩·西尔维斯特四世,反对教宗帕夏尔二世.
te: Maginulfo is elected Antipope Sylvester IV in opposition to Pope Paschal II.
dz: 马吉努尔福被选为安提波佩·西尔维斯特四世,反对教宗帕夏尔二世.
de: Maginulfo is elected Antipope Sylvester IV in opposition to Pope Paschal II.

t: 由教皇乌尔班二世召集，引发了第一次圣地十字军东征。
te: called by Pope Urban II, it led to the First Crusade to the Holy Land.
dz: 克莱蒙会议开始：由教皇乌尔班二世召集，引发了第一次圣地十字军东征。
de: The Council of Clermont begins: called by Pope Urban II, it led to the First Crusade to the Holy Land.

t: 西哥特人在国王阿拉里克一世的带领下，翻越阿尔卑斯山，入侵意大利北部。
te: The Visigoths, led by king Alaric I, cross the Alps and invade northern Italy.
dz: 西哥特人在国王阿拉里克一世的带领下，翻越阿尔卑斯山，入侵意大利北部。
de: The Visigoths, led by king Alaric I, cross the Alps and invade northern Italy.

t: 旧圣彼得大殿由教宗西尔维斯特一世所尊崇.
te: The old St. Peter's Basilica is consecrated by Pope Sylvester I.
dz: 旧圣彼得大殿由教宗西尔维斯特一世所尊崇.
de: The old St. Peter's Basilica is consecrated by Pope Sylvester I.
